background: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group is Japan's largest bank and one of the largest in the world, the holding company of MUFG Bank and Mitsubishi UFJ Trust, with a large stake in Morgan Stanley and banking subsidiaries in the US and Southeast Asia.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest at A-, all on a stable outlook, with no move since a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 8 Apr 2020. CET1 of 12.9% is below the median of Asian banks and has fallen 1.0 points since 30 Jun 2025, and it is the only ratio the paragraph carries to 30 Jun 2026. The ratings, steady for years, carry most of the weight here. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
